subject: ACME pilot — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: ACME pilot — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Alice — great to connect earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from call:
- ACME will run a 6-week pilot focused on customer support summarization + intent routing.
- Primary traffic shape: baseline ~1.2M tokens/week, peak observed in test runs ~2.5M tokens/week.
- Key success metrics: latency < 300ms P95 for short queries, summary quality (human eval) > 85%.

Open items / asks for ACME:
- Confirm an expected monthly token burn range (low / expected / high). You mentioned 5M - 10M/month as the band — can you confirm numbers in a quick spreadsheet?
- Confirm internal pilot budget for month-to-month (ballpark $/month). Even a range helps us size credits and recommend a unit price.

Redwood next steps / asks:
- We’ll provision the pilot workspace and allocate initial trial credits.
- I’ll escalate an initial credit extension request today and follow up with exact numbers and approval timeframe.
- Rishi from our team will reach out about telemetry collection (integration with your staging env).

Attachments: pilot-trial-terms.pdf (summary of trial terms and what the credits cover)

Proposed target economics (we discussed on the call):
- Standard target: ~$150 / 1M tokens for our curated open model (varies by model and quantization).
- For pilots we can be flexible: short-term promotional credits + a temporary pilot rate if needed.

Next steps: can you reply with a one-line confirmation of the monthly token ranges (low / expected / high) and your target budget range? I’ll push the credit extension for the amount we discussed and confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>

Marissa — thanks for the recap and for moving quickly. Confirming numbers from our side (see attached estimates):

- Monthly token burn (est): low 4.8M / expected 5.2M / high 11M
- Peak weekly: ~2.5M (as discussed)
- Pilot budget: we can allocate ~$10k/month for tooling and model costs for the pilot phase; procurement needs a clear credit cap to avoid surprises.

Request: Can Redwood extend an additional $5k in trial credits for the pilot window? That should cover our initial spikes and let the team run the scripted tests we have scheduled next week. If you can provide a quick conversion (credits -> approximate tokens) that’ll help procurement sign off.

Attachment: acme-pilot-estimates.xlsx (breakdown of request and expected traffic)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m sync if that helps.

Best,
Alice

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME pilot — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Alice — this is perfect and helpful. I’ve routed the request to our pilot credits committee and we can approve an initial extension. Summary of approval and unit economics: 

Credit approval:
- Approved: $5,000 in trial credits applied to ACME pilot workspace today. Neha (cc’d) will confirm when credits are posted.
- We can re-evaluate additional top-ups after the first two weeks of telemetry (we’ll review burn rate).

How to think about conversion (approx):
- Baseline pilot rate for curated open model: $150 / 1M tokens. At that rate $5k ~= 33.3M tokens.
- Promo/pilot rate we can offer: $130 / 1M tokens (one-time pilot rate) — at $130/1M, $5k ~= 38.5M tokens.
- Note: actual spend per token varies by model (higher for larger LLMs) and by features like streaming or tool calls. We’ll show you real-time token accounting in the pilot workspace.

Recommendation and next steps:
- We’ll apply the $5k now. If your telemetry shows burn tracking toward the high end (~11M/mo) we should discuss either a temporary bump or a short-term committed offer which can lower the unit price to ~$120/1M.
- Action for ACME: please confirm which model you’ll use for the pilot (our curated default is "redwood-curie-open" but you may want the higher-quality variant). That will affect unit economics.
- Rishi will send a short doc on the telemetry hooks and sample queries to ensure we capture accurate prefix caching behavior.

Attachment: credit-extension-approval.pdf (approval stub; not legally binding — paperwork to follow if you accept a committed rate)

I’ll check back after Neha confirms the credit application. If you want a 15m to walk procurement through the conversion math I’m available tomorrow morning.

—
Marissa
